row.evidence: LiveChat lists "Single Sign-On (SSO) ready ... based on SAML 2.0" only on Enterprise and its SSO guide says new agents must be registered in the IdP and added to LiveChat; no SCIM provisioning is documented.
row.notes: New row. Plans (annual, per user/mo): Starter $19 (one user only), Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise custom quote; monthly billing $25/$59/$89. SAML 2.0 SSO is Enterprise-only (native Okta and OneLogin options; Auth0 and Azure AD via custom SAML). No SCIM is documented on the pricing/feature references, the help-centre sitemap or the Text platform API docs; agents must exist before SSO sign-in. Okta OIN app is SAML + SWA. Agents and groups can be managed through the Text platform Configuration API (create/list/update/delete agents, groups; suspend/unsuspend not yet public), but private API usage is metered on every plan ($0.27 per 1,000 requests), so api_tax is true in the "sold separately" sense. "Allowed domains" lets teammates with the company domain join without an invitation on all plans. None by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM documented anywhere on livechat.com or platform.text.com.

limitations.text: suspend_agent, unsuspend_agent and approve_agent are "not yet available for public use".
Private API usage is billed per request on every plan ($0.27 per 1,000 up to 1M/month); Marketplace apps are not billed.

user_api.notes: All Configuration API methods are POST to https://api.livechatinc.com/v3.6/configuration/action/<action>.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML and SWA only (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Not in the Entra SaaS tutorial list; LiveChat says Azure AD works through custom SAML.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin's connector page was not loaded; LiveChat lists OneLogin as a native SSO option.

jumpcloud.notes: No JumpCloud integration article for LiveChat in the JumpCloud docs navigation (direct URL returned 403).

fallbacks.other_sync: Allowed domains: teammates with the company email domain can join without an invitation (all plans)
